name: Crystl
summary: macOS terminal for running and orchestrating multiple AI coding agents, with git worktrees, schedules and SSH.
description: Crystl is a macOS terminal built for CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Kimi and OpenCode. It supports multi-vendor, multi-agent orchestration and a super-orchestrator that can manage other orchestrators across projects. Built-in capabilities listed on the site include git worktree isolation, SSH, task management, agent status monitoring, automations, scheduled agents and an agent-usable CLI.
features: Claude Code, Codex, Kimi and OpenCode
